name: Object Layer
description: The domain that owns the canonical, content-addressed object definition: its schema, its identity and its lifecycle.

acceptedAnswer.text: An Object Layer is a canonical, content-addressed object definition: an item label, mechanical content and render content under a schema version. Its identity is the CID of its canonical bytes.

mainEntity.name: Is the item id the identity of an Object Layer?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The item id is a semantic label. Several Object Layer definitions may share one item id. The identity is the Object Layer CID, computed from the canonical content.

mainEntity.name: How do Object Layers reach the blockchain?

acceptedAnswer.text: ItemLedger binds an Object Layer CID to an ERC-1155 token type. The token id is derived from the CID. Ownership and supply are ledger state and stay outside the Object Layer content.

mainEntity.name: What state is the Object Layer domain in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Alpha. Authoring, publication, content identity, the render pipeline and the purge path are implemented and in use.
